optimizedDescription.value: IndexProjectGraph forwards prepared project indexing inputs to an open provider while hosts retain I/O, locking, and process concerns.

optimizedContext.value:
# IndexProjectGraph

## Rules

- `IndexProjectGraph.execute(input)` MUST call `provider.index()` once with `IndexOptions` built from `projectRoot`, `workspaces`, `graphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion`, `vcsRoot`, optional `vcsRef`, optional `onProgress`, and force intent; return `IndexResult` unchanged.
- When `input.force === true`, forward `force: true` to `provider.index(...)`. Never call `provider.recreate()` directly; provider owns destructive reset, generation rotation, lock policy. Omitted/false force requests no recreation.
- `IndexProjectGraphInput` MUST contain opened `provider: CodeGraphProvider`, `projectRoot: string`, `workspaces: WorkspaceIndexTarget[]`, `graphConfig: ProjectGraphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion: string`, `vcsRoot: string | null`; MAY contain `vcsRef: string`, `force: boolean`, `onProgress: IndexProgressCallback`. Forward `vcsRoot` unchanged.
- Use case MUST NOT resolve workspaces from `specd.yaml`, acquire locks, spawn subprocesses, or directly reset provider/store.
- `createIndexProjectGraph()` in composition returns stateless `IndexProjectGraph`.

## Constraints

- MUST NOT open/close provider.
- MUST NOT acquire/release graph indexing lock.
- Parse failures remain `IndexResult.errors`; use case MUST NOT throw for per-file errors.
